r1.name: DSC vector computation

access.notes: DSC vectors for fcc and simple-cubic lattices are derived from Σ and the crystal structure using standard crystallographic formulas. No external download needed; implement with numpy.

r1.notes: The agent must compute or generate the DSC translation sets for each Σ from crystallographic definitions.

r2.name: King & Chen geometrical criteria

access.notes: The method is described in the public literature; implement the test: a reaction is allowed if the residue vector belongs to the chosen DSC set.

r2.notes: The agent implements the King & Chen algorithm from the description provided in the instruction.

access.notes: List of 30 Burgers vectors: APB ⟨110⟩/2, Shockley ⟨112⟩/6, super-Shockley ⟨112⟩/3. Explicit vectors are provided in the instruction.

r3.notes: The set of 30 representative incoming Burgers vectors; no external data required.
